column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 22989:2022 to NIST AI 100-1 (AI RMF 1.0) Schema Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the ISO/IEC 22989:2022 (Artificial intelligence concepts and terminology) and NIST AI 100-1 (AI Risk Management Framework 1.0) LinkML schemas. Both standards share an AI-system-centred conceptual model; mappings align lifecycle stages, actor roles, risk and harm constructs, and bias categories.

column10: comment
NIST AI RMF reuses the ISO/IEC 22989 definition of an AI system.
ISO/IEC 22989 models lifecycle activities as processes; NIST models them as stages. Both partition the same lifecycle.
Both enumerations partition the AI lifecycle into stages, with different granularity.
NIST AI RMF lifecycle stages are derived from the OECD lifecycle, which ISO/IEC 22989 also enumerates in Annex A.
Both labels reference the OECD plan-and-design stage.
Both labels reference the OECD collect-and-process-data stage.
Both labels reference the OECD build-and-use-model stage.
Both labels reference the OECD verify-and-validate stage.
OECD deploy stage; NIST groups deploy and use.
Both labels reference the OECD operate-and-monitor stage.
ISO/IEC 22989 stakeholder role and NIST AI actor refer to the same role-played-in-AI-context concept.
Both enumerate roles or tasks performed by actors involved in AI systems.
ISO/IEC 22989 AI subject corresponds to NIST's affected-individuals-or-communities actor.
Both refer to end users of an AI system.
ISO/IEC 22989 relevant authority aligns with NIST's governance-and-oversight actor role.
ISO/IEC 22989 AI partner roles overlap with NIST third-party entities providing supporting services.
ISO/IEC 22989 AI auditor performs test, evaluation, verification and validation similar to NIST's TEVV actor.
Both model risk associated with an AI system using source, event, consequence and likelihood.
ISO/IEC 22989 societal impact categories overlap with NIST harm categories.
Both enumerate categories of bias relevant to AI systems; ISO/IEC 22989 follows ISO/IEC TR 24027.
ISO/IEC 22989 data-handling processes align with the NIST data-and-input system dimension.
ISO/IEC 22989 AI model class corresponds to the NIST AI-model system dimension.
ISO/IEC 22989 task class corresponds to the NIST task-and-output system dimension.
